reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Provision of a USD 80 million loan to finance capex and working capital needs of Sodrugestvo Group's subsidiaries in Turkey. Working capital portion of the EBRD loan is expected to be syndicated (B Loan for the account of commercial bank(s) in the amount of up to USD 25 million). The loan will be utilized to finance part of the acquisition of a production facility in Izmir/Turkey and further capex programme including the modernisation of the acquired facility along with working capital financing for expansion of the operations in Turkey.

condition.narrative: Provision of a USD 80 million loan to finance capex and working capital needs of Sodrugestvo Group's subsidiaries in Turkey. Working capital portion of the EBRD loan is expected to be syndicated (B Loan for the account of commercial bank(s) in the amount of up to USD 25 million).
